component.name: Telltale Analysis
component.summary: Frame-by-frame video review tool for athletes, coaches and parents.

description.p: Review footage the way TV sport analysts do: step through clips frame by frame, compare up to four camera angles side by side in sync, and draw on the video to point things out.

ul.li: Frame-accurate stepping with the scroll wheel, touchpad or an on-screen jog wheel
Projects made of scenes, each showing up to four synced clips
Arrows, lines, circles and freehand drawing, pinned to their frame
Count-down / count-up timer against any frame
